description: User authentication: login, register, session management.

endpoints.description: Authenticate a user with email and password.
endpoints.notes: The demo currently stores passwords in plaintext in users.json. Backend MUST hash passwords (bcrypt). Never return the password field in responses.

success.description: Same as login response (auto-login after register).

endpoints.notes: New users start with 0 entries, 0 totalSpent, role 'user'.

endpoints.description: Get the current authenticated user's profile (refreshed from DB).

response.description: Same user object as login (without password), with fresh entries/totalSpent.

endpoints.notes: The frontend calls this to refresh the user session data. Must return the latest entries count and totalSpent.

businessRules: Passwords MUST be hashed (bcrypt or argon2) — the demo stores them in plaintext for simplicity.
Never return the password field in any response.
The 'role' field determines access: 'admin' can access /admin routes, 'user' cannot.
Admin accounts should only be created via direct DB access, not through the register endpoint.
Session/token management is left to the backend implementation (JWT recommended).
